[[AS Saint-Etienne]] won '''Division 1 season 1975/1976''' of the [[Ligue de Football Professionnel|French Association Football League]] with 57 points.

* [[Stade Rennais FC]]: Runner-up, winner of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]] group A
* [[Stade Lavallois]]: Third place, winner of barrages
